BiblicalUsage: Ahishar was 'over the household' — the steward of Solomon's palace, named once in the list of the king's officials, with his office and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on a steward's name. Yet the list that holds it is a portrait of a kingdom at peace: officers, districts, and a house in order.
RelatedPeople: Ahishar, Steward of Solomon; King Solomon
